title.zh: 将八打雁省莱梅里市镇马萨利西小学的名称变更为帕亚庞伊巴巴小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Masalisi Primary School in the Municipality of Lemery, Province of Batangas, to Payapang Ibaba Primary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Masalisi Primary School in the Municipality of Lemery, Province of Batangas, to Payapang Ibaba Primary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4333_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Masalisi Primary School in the Municipality of Lemery, Province of Batangas, is hereby changed to Payapang Ibaba Primary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
